rationale: study/model_pin.v1.json freezes a single model so one study is reproducible. It cannot express a comparison, because its changeRule invalidates the method version as soon as the model changes. This contract states what must be identical across backends for a multi backend result to be a controlled comparison rather than several separate studies reported together.

runtime: agent tool surface: identical tool names, identical arity
candidate count default for the H4 best of N manipulation
L1 to L5 interaction contract and consent routing
trial sequencing, counterbalancing and A/B variant assignment
generated study scene and its stable object identifiers

backends.note: Mirrors study/model_pin.v1.json, which remains the authority for the single backend run.

equivalenceRules: Every backend runs the identical held constant artifact set, proven by heldConstantDigest.
Every backend is offered the identical agent tool surface, proven by toolSurfaceDigest.
Every backend uses the same candidate count default, so the H4 best of N manipulation means the same thing in each arm.
A backend whose status is not registered may not contribute trials to any analysis.
Differences between backends are admissible only if the differing field is listed in mayVary.
A per backend systemPromptHash difference is expected and permitted, because prompt formats differ between providers. It is recorded per trial so a prompt change within a backend is still detectable.
changeRule: Adding or removing a held constant artifact, changing the tool surface, or changing the candidate count default requires a new comparison version and re-locking heldConstantDigest and toolSurfaceDigest. Registering a new backend does not, provided every invariant still matches.
